concept.centerRule: A Scene belongs when faith, trust, belief, unbelief, or faithfulness is explicit, or when a later Scripture witness directly identifies an earlier Scene as faith. Shared vocabulary never erases differences in object, evidence, action, time, or outcome.

characterAnchors.label: Abraham
characterAnchors.note: Believes a promise while childless, acts under testing, and becomes a major later witness in arguments about faith.

characterAnchors.label: Moses
characterAnchors.note: Faces Israel’s belief and unbelief and is himself judged for failing to trust at Meribah.

characterAnchors.label: Rahab
characterAnchors.note: Acts on a report before Jericho falls and is remembered in Hebrews and James.

characterAnchors.label: David
characterAnchors.note: Voices and enacts confidence under threat while the Psalms keep fear, waiting, and trust together.

characterAnchors.label: Hezekiah
characterAnchors.note: Trusts, reforms, prepares, prays, and speaks courage during Assyrian pressure.

characterAnchors.label: Mary
characterAnchors.note: Asks how the announcement will occur and is blessed for believing it will be fulfilled.

characterAnchors.label: Peter
characterAnchors.note: Acts, fears, doubts, confesses, denies, and is addressed as someone whose faith is prayed for through failure.

characterAnchors.label: Thomas
characterAnchors.note: Rejects secondhand testimony, receives direct evidence, and frames the blessing on later unseen belief.

characterAnchors.label: Paul
characterAnchors.note: Develops faith within arguments about righteousness, grace, works, love, suffering, community, and testimony.

characterAnchors.label: Jesus Christ
characterAnchors.note: Receives belief, names faith and doubt, becomes the object of apostolic faith, and is called faithful and true.

concept.throughline: The pattern moves from promise and wilderness testing through songs of trust, prophetic warnings, Jesus’ encounters, apostolic arguments, communal formation, and faithful witness under pressure.

pivots.title: wilderness belief and refusal

nodes.title: Peter walks, fears, sinks, and is rescued

nodes.title: Faith without works is called dead
